indexPrompt.gen-a-stuck-pixel-and-a-stuck-gain: The camp's scanner photographs 4-pixel thumbnails and hands each one to this chapter's autoencoder, the encoder and decoder the running example defines, trained on LEFT and RIGHT. Two faults showed up in the same morning: a thumbnail of LEFT with its bottom-left pixel stuck low, so the reading is (1, 0, 0.7, 0), and a reading of the same scene with every pixel 0.1 too high, so the reading is (1.1, 0.1, 1.1, 0.1). Give the reconstruction's mean squared error against the right target in each case.
